div.div:
Solid arrows = request path · dashed purple = JWKS fetch · dashed red = rejection exits (with live-observed codes) · dashed green = response.
Three verifications of two tokens: client JWT at ❷ (Apigee) and ❻ (Envoy); Google ID token at IAM. The app itself verifies nothing.
